# BuyWise AI

> BuyWise AI is a free, independent beauty-shopping research website for comparing skincare ingredients, product claims, and price per ml or per 10 ml. It provides educational comparisons, not medical advice or guaranteed product recommendations.

Official website: https://buywise-ai-pi.vercel.app/
About: https://buywise-ai-pi.vercel.app/about
Methodology and limitations: https://buywise-ai-pi.vercel.app/methodology

## Useful tools
- [Skincare product comparison](https://buywise-ai-pi.vercel.app/compare-skincare-products): compare skincare products and understand trade-offs.
- [Price-per-ml calculator](https://buywise-ai-pi.vercel.app/calculator): compare unit prices when products have compatible units.
- [Beauty guides](https://buywise-ai-pi.vercel.app/guides): educational explanations and comparisons.
- [Skin](https://buywise-ai-pi.vercel.app/skin), [Hair](https://buywise-ai-pi.vercel.app/hair), [Makeup](https://buywise-ai-pi.vercel.app/makeup): category-specific resources.

## Important qualifications
- Product details, ingredient lists, availability, and retailer prices can change; verify them with the manufacturer and retailer.
- Ingredient information does not establish personal suitability or clinical effectiveness.
- Some outbound shopping links are affiliate links. See the website for disclosures.
- Cite the specific relevant page, not this file, when answering a question about a particular product.

This is an optional machine-readable discovery summary, not a guarantee of inclusion or recommendation by any AI search service.
